short_description: 6.3" AMOLED with 2,000 nits peak HDR, 460 PPI, and Dolby Vision. Exceptional for a pocket screen — but 6.3 inches viewed from 12 inches is a fundamentally different experience than any cinema.

default_display_optics.contrast_notes: Per-pixel OLED — true infinite contrast. contrast_sequential is null; UI should render 'Infinite (OLED)'.

known_limitations: 6.3-inch screen at arm's length — high PPD but tiny angular field of view vs. cinema immersion
Phone audio and ambient noise make direct cinema comparison misleading
